name: web-dark-learning-platform-with-lime-gradient-buttons-and-3d-glass-objects
title: Dark course platform with lime-to-green gradient buttons, a 3D metal-sphere hero and iridescent glass rings on black cards
whatItIs: A green-black textured board with white-framed sections: a black hero 'Keep Learning On Track' with a lime button and a 3D mechanical sphere with floating gradient course cards and a 1.2K counter, black video-lesson cards with a glass ring, a white testimonials block with a lime gradient Leave Feedback button, a black achievements block with an iridescent glass stack and award logos, dark leadership tiles with icons and arrow buttons, and a foundational courses list with tag pills.
whatItMeans: Modern and premium; glassy 3D objects and lime gradients make learning feel high-tech.
techniques: Add iridescent 3D glass objects to dark cards.
Frame black sections in white rounded frames.
List courses with hairlines and tag pills.

vocabulary.definition: A button filled with a colour gradient.
A glass object with rainbow reflections.
A white border around a dark section.
A list line with tags, date and Explore button.
